title: RT Operational Regime Definition
purpose: Define an RT operational regime as a derived behavior-mode of RT_core without yet naming L or NL as specific regimes.

core_definition.RT_operational_regime: A repeatable derived mode of RT_core continuation under declared admissibility, residue, orientation, and context conditions.
core_definition.trace_requirement: Every regime must constructively trace to RT_core := [(ℰ≠0) ⇔R δα(ℰ>0)].
core_definition.regime_naming: No specific regime-family labels are assigned in this patch.

governance_rules: A regime is not an axiomatic floor.
A regime must declare its admissibility context.
A regime must specify whether residue affects continuation.

notes: The regime definition is derived from RT_core and does not introduce a new axiomatic floor.
This patch is governance and architecture only.
The regime definition remains downstream of RT_core and does not supersede the canonical root expression.
The new term is also registered in the lexicon gap queue as a GAP_OPEN candidate.
